<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" targetNamespace="http://example.com/restaurant">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Meal order"/>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerHandover" name="Buzzer and readiness information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestCall" name="Call for guest"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestArrival" name="Guest arrives at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealHandover" name="Meal handover"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest orders and collects meal" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Guest_Start" name="Guest feels hungry and enters restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_ChooseDish" name="Choose a dish from the changing meal range"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_WaitTurn" name="Wait until it is his turn"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with employee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Guest_Pay" name="Pay for order"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer" name="Receive buzzer and readiness information" messageRef="Message_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Guest_WaitForBuzzerOrCall" name="Wait for buzzer or employee call"/>

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_BuzzerRings_Definition" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Guest_EmployeeCalls" name="Employee calls">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_EmployeeCalls_Definition" messageRef="Message_GuestCall"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Guest_GoToHatch" name="Go to service hatch"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Guest_EatMeal" name="Eat meal"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_1" sourceRef="Guest_Start" targetRef="Guest_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_2" sourceRef="Guest_ChooseDish" targetRef="Guest_WaitTurn"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_13" sourceRef="Guest_ReceiveMeal" targetRef="Guest_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_14" sourceRef="Guest_EatMeal" targetRef="Guest_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Restaurant" name="Prepare and hand over meal" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="Restaurant_Lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_EnterOrderInPOS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_CollectPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_SetUpBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_InformChef</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_SetOffBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_GuestArrives</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_FiveMinutesElapsed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_CallGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_HandOverMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Chef" name="Chef">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Chef_ReceiveOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Chef_PrepareMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Chef_PlaceMealInHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Chef_InformEmployee</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Restaurant_Start" name="Meal order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Restaurant_Start_OrderDefinition" messageRef="Message_Order"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Employee_EnterOrderInPOS" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Employee_CollectPayment" name="Collect money from guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Employee_SetUpBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Employee_HandOverBuzzer" name="Pass buzzer and explain when dinner is ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Employee_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Chef_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive meal order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Chef_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Chef_PlaceMealInHatch" name="Place meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Chef_InformEmployee" name="Inform employee meal is in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Employee_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer" name="Wait for guest or five minutes"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Employee_GuestArrives" name="Guest appears at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Employee_GuestArrives_Definition" messageRef="Message_GuestArrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Employee_FiveMinutesElapsed" name="Five minutes elapsed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Employee_FiveMinutesElapsed_Definition">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_CallGuest" name="Call for guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Employee_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Restaurant_End" name="Meal handed over"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_1" sourceRef="Restaurant_Start" targetRef="Employee_EnterOrderInPOS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_2" sourceRef="Employee_EnterOrderInPOS" targetRef="Employee_CollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_3" sourceRef="Employee_CollectPayment" targetRef="Employee_SetUpBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_4" sourceRef="Employee_SetUpBuzzer" targetRef="Employee_HandOverBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_5" sourceRef="Employee_HandOverBuzzer" targetRef="Employee_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_6" sourceRef="Employee_InformChef" targetRef="Chef_ReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_7" sourceRef="Chef_ReceiveOrder" targetRef="Chef_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_8" sourceRef="Chef_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Chef_PlaceMealInHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_9" sourceRef="Chef_PlaceMealInHatch" targetRef="Chef_InformEmployee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_10" sourceRef="Chef_InformEmployee" targetRef="Employee_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_11" sourceRef="Employee_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_12" sourceRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer" targetRef="Employee_GuestArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_13" sourceRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer" targetRef="Employee_FiveMinutesElapsed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_14" sourceRef="Employee_GuestArrives" targetRef="Employee_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_15" sourceRef="Employee_FiveMinutesElapsed" targetRef="Employee_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_16" sourceRef="Employee_CallGuest" targetRef="Employee_WaitForGuestOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_17" sourceRef="Employee_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Restaurant_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Restaurant_Collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Restaurant" name="Restaurant" processRef="Process_Restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Meal order" sourceRef="Guest_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Restaurant_Start" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" name="Payment" sourceRef="Guest_Pay" targetRef="Employee_CollectPayment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerHandover" name="Buzzer and readiness information" sourceRef="Employee_HandOverBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings" sourceRef="Employee_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_BuzzerRings" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestCall" name="Call for guest" sourceRef="Employee_CallGuest" targetRef="Guest_EmployeeCalls" messageRef="Message_GuestCall"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestArrival" name="Guest arrives" sourceRef="Guest_ArriveAtHatch" targetRef="Employee_GuestArrives" messageRef="Message_GuestArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealHandover" name="Meal handover" sourceRef="Employee_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveMeal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
